title: Record the P104 fiber-tag mismatch on one row/column pair.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

On the 104 published P104 labels, the phase-uniform row tag `z ⊗ q_j` and the column tag `r_i ⊗ z` are never the same 81-bit translation. They disagree on the one-dimensional shared line exactly when the two labels have different weight classes modulo 4. The published witness `(386, 405)` is a mixed pair: shared-line flips `0` and `1`, Hamming distance 20, separated by bit 11.

This is a finite tag obstruction. It is not a scalar saving, a paid-profile improvement, or a κ change. Selected conditional κ stays `836330098538459/500000000000000000` (`0.001672660197076918`). The inherited scaffold excess 44,096 is untouched. Minimum Hamming distance on the 10,816 ordered pairs is 6, so a shared-line agreement is never a full-address agreement.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f` (canonical `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` main, priority revision 6).
- Task: `p104-side-correction`, scope **refined**. The card allows one chronological cut or one hosting obstruction. The full correction program is not constructed.
- Handoff: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19034676
- Ordered eligible #1166 handoffs after dropping work already delivered, matched by an open PR, or listed in this round through #4149:
  1. `(7, 18)` / `(7, 20)` functional census (comment 19021170, question 1). Question 2 is the soundness proof in #4148.
  2. Invoice-level audit of the composed T488 ownership and outputs (comment 19022532, question 1). Question 2 is closed by #3796.
  3. Physical rank-8/u2 source/consumer contract (comment 19029639).
  4. Downstream consumer that keeps the #3943 encoded endpoint (comment 19032700, task 2). Task 1 is #3956.
  5. **This fiber-tag reconciliation (comment 19034676).**
- Dropped before that cut: the #3605 wrapper (open #3681); typed actual-width H (#4123, #4127); single-hub and third-hub tariffs (#4124, #4145); the L22 census refinements (#4117–#4120); the six-tape F0 ledger (#4114); tensor-pairing review (#4113); shear words and transvections (#4126, #4135, #4146); the #3942 review and two-neighbour invoices (#4134, #4122, #4128, #4144); the #3690 adapter refresh (open #3967); adjacent uniform completion (#4133, #4136, #4140); the separated A2 audit (#4112); the index bridge, encoder fiber, and `(N-P)⊗M` consumer (#4125, #4131, #4143); many-axis guard (#4142); event 58 (#4149); stock floors and the log_q parent (#4130, #4141).
- Predecessor labels, witness, and gauge `z = 420`: PR #3954 head `f1e2839819959cd0534d008be91ed5b79ec55a6a`, retained by PR #3966 head `3e2d70630fde46847c8938564576d78da48d101d`. `RESULT.json` SHA-256 `ce05a27ebc98677bec4febaa488fa03f5b6fc60216aa43b34298444d12f7ab6c`. That head is not a Git object on this base. `labels.json` is the vendored array.
- Overlap refresh at 2026-10-20T03:11:19Z covered 842 open PR bodies and 2670 discussion records. No open PR compares these two fiber tags on the published witness.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3. Registered replay:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-fiber-tag-seam
```

Passed locally as `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-fiber-tag-seam outcome=negative-result`.

Direct checks, including `-O`:

```sh
python3.12 -B research/p104-fiber-tag-seam/verify.py
```

print `PASS_P104_FIBER_TAG_SEAM pairs=10816 full_equal=0 mixed_shared_disagree=5376 same_shared_agree=5440 min_hamming=6 witness=386/405 shared_flips=0/1 ham=20 helper_disagrees_on_witness=true no_new_kappa`.

`scripts/research_package.py --check-only` passed. `scripts/check_research_commit.py --check-source-history` passed at `4ffcdaee5d6255a9cea1fe53a5424435068089d0`, with source history `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`. `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py` returned `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`.

The checker tests `O` on all 512 vectors, the marginal-sum separation from the uniform tag, every ordered pair, the witness character at bit 11, and a control that the zero image can agree. Not run: the PR #3954 and PR #3966 executables, Lean, Docker, and the selected cold replay.

## Open next questions

Linked from `research/p104-fiber-tag-seam/TASK.json`:

1. Can a paid correction of the six disagreeing bits on a same-class pair, such as label 32 against itself, be hosted without repaying the inherited excess 44,096?
2. Does a non-orthogonal address change make the witness pair `(386, 405)` share one translation on the full address and on the helper tag `a`?
